719-3510-4288-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-4288-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1829-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

654-1308-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1090-6867-6967-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

656-5660-6872.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-997-7198.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

3835-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

145-2816-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
145-2816-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Umbral Mantle attached using Serra's Sanctum's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2104-4423-4482-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-4482-6886.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

511-817-1887-4050-6441.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3641-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3641-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2511-2523-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2511-2523-5560.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

372-3306-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-3306-4125.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

539-2034-4677-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

11-5261--41.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-5261--41.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy the extra turn spell, and return the original extra turn spell to your hand.
Resolve the copy of the extra turn spell, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

652-1543-2247.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other planeswalkers.
Rowan's Talent attached to Teferi.
Teferi has an amount of loyalty counters on it equal to or greater than eleven minus the number of other planeswalkers you control.
652-1543-2247.description:
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter to Teferi.
Repeat step 1 for each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Rowan's Talent triggers, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve both Teferi abilities, causing you to take four extra turns after this one.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Teferi by putting zero loyalty counters on it.
Rowan's Talent triggers, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve both Teferi abilities, causing you to put two loyalty counters on it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2.
Repeat from step 6 two additional times.
Move to your final extra turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2178-4917.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jan Jansen.
You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
2034-2178-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Construct, adding {C}{C}.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the remaining Construct.
The Construct dies, triggering Jan Jansen, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jensen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

2744-2808-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Enduring Scalelord and Clever Impersonator triggers.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 4.

2713-3552-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
2713-3552-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {W}.
Pay {W} to create a 1/1 Warrior token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
